title: The Math Exam Vanished At 6 A.M. 🤖 Ep.1

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 6:03 a.m. Staff room. Mr. Kamal's briefcase. [beat] Inside — tomorrow's math final. [beat] By 6:04… [beat] GONE.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: Twenty years I taught this school! [beat] ONE paper! [beat] One paper and I'm finished!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Find it by morning, Kamal. [beat] Or every student re-takes a NEW exam. [beat] Harder. [beat] MUCH harder.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait — WHY do we get punished? [beat] Sir, nobody even asked us!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Nix. [beat] If we find that paper ourselves… we're legends. [beat] If we don't… [beat] we're dead men.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: Focus. Facts only. [beat] Window latch — opened from INSIDE. Chalk dust on the sill… [beat] and tiny footprints.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: Tiny footprints. [beat] A child… or a trained small agent. [beat] I've already said too much.

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: You heard it here FIRST! Teacher lost the exam! [beat] Or sold it! [beat] Or it never existed! [beat] Six versions — pick your favorite!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: She's right… [beat] who believes a man who can't guard one folder?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Relax, sir. [beat] One camera watches that corridor. [beat] Old. Ugly. [beat] But it never blinks.

lines.speaker: mira
lines.text: 2 a.m. footage. There. [beat] A hoodie. [beat] Moving straight… for the briefcase.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Zoom in! Enhance! [beat] …That walk. [beat] I KNOW that walk.

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: We ALL know that walk. [beat] The question is… [beat] who's brave enough to say the name.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Follow for part two — [beat] because that hoodie… [beat] belongs to someone we see every single day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Twelve suspects. One hoodie. [beat] And a walk everybody recognized… [beat] but nobody dared to name.
